meta.note: 80/20 program. Priority: climbing V12, longevity. Finger recovery ongoing. Right knee, left QL, right shoulder limitations accounted for.
meta.db_weight_convention: working_weight for dumbbell exercises = total weight (both DBs combined). e.g. working_weight: 60 = 30 lb per hand.
changelog_3_2: WARMUP OVERHAUL — climbing coach prescription for V12 goal at 32
REMOVED from all warmups: ankle circles, knee circles, hip circles (low value at this fitness level)
REMOVED from all blocks: couch stretch (requires wall) → replaced with Spiderman lunge passive hold
REMOVED: wrist circles → replaced with wrist rocks on floor (more effective, saves time)
REMOVED: shoulder circles split by arm → bilateral backward then forward (correct anatomically)

ADDED both warmups: glute bridge, clamshells L/R, cat-cow, wrist rocks, squat rocks, leg swings F/B per side, lateral leg swings per side, hip CARs per side, World's Greatest Stretch per side, shoulder circles bilateral, step-downs per side, bird dog per side
ADDED climbing warmup only: Copenhagen plank per side (highest demand, bridges into climbing intensity)
ADDED lift warmup only: hip hinges, thoracic rotation, wall sit, squat-to-hinge flow (lift-specific pattern prime)
POST-STRETCH both: couch stretch → Spiderman lunge passive hold per side 40s
THURSDAY MOBILITY: couch stretch → Spiderman lunge passive hold per side 45s
WEIGHT UPDATES from RPE log: pull-ups 50→55 (RPE 6 at 55lb on 2026-04-14), RDL 155→165 (consistent RPE 5-7 at 145lb)
OHP progression fixed 0.875→0.833 (50lb total = 25lb/hand, clean DB weight)

timer_routine.name: Climbing Warmup
timer_routine.description: Floor series → standing dynamic → climbing-specific. ~8–9 min.

blocks.label: Glute bridge. On back, feet flat, drive hips up, hard squeeze at top
Clamshells — right side. Feet stacked, rotate top knee up like a clamshell
Cat-cow. Hands and knees. Arch up slowly then drop belly. Breathe
Wrist rocks. Both hands flat on floor, rock forward and back through full range
Stand up. Squat rocks — feet shoulder width, deep squat, drive knees out, rock ankles forward
Leg swings front/back — right leg. Hold wall, swing right leg forward and back, full range
Lateral leg swings — right leg. Face wall, swing right leg side to side
Hip CARs — right leg. Hand on wall, drive knee up and around in a full slow deliberate circle. Own the range
World's Greatest Stretch — right. Step right foot forward into lunge, drop left knee, reach right arm to sky and rotate through
Shoulder circles — both arms together. Big backward rolls then forward
Step-downs — right foot on bench or block. Slow controlled single-leg lower. Left foot barely touches floor
Bird dog. Hands and knees. Right arm and left leg. Slow, squeeze, controlled
Bird dog — right arm, left leg
Bird dog — left arm, right leg
Copenhagen plank. Top foot on bench, right side first. Highest demand — bridges you straight into climbing
